description: This file implements a simple in-memory cache class 'SimpleCache3' that adheres to the PSR-16 CacheInterface. It provides methods for caching, retrieving, deleting, and managing multiple cache entries within PHP applications.

classes.name: SimpleCache3
classes.description: A default in-memory cache implementation adhering to PSR-16, allowing cache storage and retrieval within the application runtime.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all cache entries by resetting the internal cache array.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a cache entry identified by the given key.

methods.name: deleteMultiple
methods.description: Removes multiple cache entries specified by an iterable collection of keys.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with the given key or returns a default if the key does not exist.

methods.name: getMultiple
methods.description: Retrieves multiple cache entries for the given iterable of keys, returning an array of key-value pairs.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a cache entry exists for the specified key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in the cache with the associated key and optional TTL.

methods.name: setMultiple
methods.description: Stores multiple key-value pairs in the cache, with an optional TTL.
